projects.title: gameAssets_v3 – Squished Battler
projects.blurb: Art and tools for Squished Battler, a portrait 9:16 auto-battler for Google Play. Fruits and veggies run for the top of the arena while a black ant army tries to eat them; every kill leaves juice on the floor.

projects.title: Bunny Brigade
projects.blurb: A rabbits-vs-foxes lane battler with a merge backpack, built with TypeScript + Vite and drawn entirely on a canvas (no image files).
